These exact saved bytes were packaged and tested; do not rebuild them for a future approval.

New native API surface: CommandContext.appStateJson, CommandsCapability.setAppState(Data), CommandSettingLock and required CommandRunner.locked(context:) throws -> CommandSettingLock? callback (direct protocol implementers must add it; CommandHandler provides optional locked closure defaulting to nil). FormFocusOptions, FormFocusNextOptions, FormFocusTarget, FormWidgetEvent, and FormCapability focus/focusNext/focusedField/moveInGroup/attachFocusTarget/notifyWidgetEvent.

Whole local-prebuilt consumer scheme passed 333 engine tests and 9 UI tests on arm64 iOS27.2 Simulator. Both arm64 device/iOS and simulator slices target iOS17.0 minimum; native objects and all11 ZIP files are associated with reviewed raw inputs and consumed framework. Actual Xcode-processed simulator binary matches saved ZIP. Independent Apple stage review C0/I0/M0, report SHA af326c5188e4c8a1e1abd459705902a17622f5db68a3ae4ab48d5c8f8ed2b15c.

This establishes local-prebuilt acceptance only. Existing default Package.swift remains published BASE552d/55228; new native APIs require separately authorized future publication and exact pin plus actual default-consumer verification. No physical iOS device execution, native macOS, Android APK or NuGet support claim. Existing font registration/controlled-bundle and external-deployment-bundle limits remain; no wider font compatibility is established here.

Feature WASM canonical identity is runtime-payloads-e352d80f0a7c2851, distinct from BASE8b90259d5d279d4a despite unchanged runtime gitlink3c55. Its local preparation/review and any future release approval are separate; never retag or reuse the BASE bundle as this feature payload.
